warnings.headline: Blowing snow, yellow level, Parts of the mountains in Salten and Helgeland, 2026-11-14T18:00:00+00:00, 2026-11-15T05:00:00+00:00
warnings.description: Local blowing snow is expected on mountain roads above 400 masl. due to strong wind. Open lowland areas are also exposed. The risk increases Saturday evening and decrease early Sunday morning
warnings.instruction: Locally difficult driving conditions: Use correct tires and drive according to the conditions. Allow extra time for travel and driving. Follow advice and check status from transport operators. Check road conditions at vegvesen.no/trafikk. Dress according to the weather conditions: Avoid unnecessary trips in exposed areas, and dress for the conditions.
areas: Parts of the mountains in Salten and Helgeland
